title: Hidden in Plain Sight: Evaluating Abstract Shape Recognition in Vision-Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating Vision-Language Models (VLMs) using the IllusionBench dataset, which contains images where abstract shapes are formed by arranging visual scene elements (e.g., clouds, forests). The methodology measures the models' perceptual biases by comparing 'shape recall' (identifying the hidden abstract shape) against 'scene recall' (identifying the background texture or scene) in zero-shot, few-shot, and fine-tuned settings.
